name: B. M. Lean
story: New Zealand Forest Service contributor based in Christchurch in the 1977 Landsat II report. Lean wrote its Canterbury windthrow account and co-authored the Hanmer fire-damaged-tree investigation.

sources.label: Ellis, Thomas and McDonnell (eds), Landsat II Investigation Programme, PEL Report 587, September 1977, affiliations p.9 and contents pp.10–13
